title: A steadier way to freelance.
tips: [{"heading":"Keep going, but make it repeatable","body":"You only get one life, and freelancing can buy back real agency. Do not rely on adrenaline alone. Build simple systems for leads, proposals, delivery, follow-up, and cash flow so good weeks can become a pattern."},{"heading":"Build where the market is already warm","body":"The opportunity is there, but the market decides what matters. Listen for urgent problems, test small offers, and look for buyers who already feel the pain before you build the big thing."},{"heading":"Proof beats hope","body":"Before going all in, collect evidence: paid pilots, waiting lists, referral signals, repeat questions, and clear product fit. A confident freelancer still checks demand before betting the runway."},{"heading":"Risk management is creative discipline","body":"Protect the downside so you can stay in the game. Use contracts, define scope, cap experiments, price for value, and keep enough runway to make good decisions instead of desperate ones."}]
